name: Namishima Itsuki
source:
The protagonist of this work.
He has a strong love for his hometown, Tatsumiya Village, and now lives alone in a house left by his grandparents.

Just like the people of Tatsumiya Village, he is passionate and innocent at heart.
He devotes himself to repairing the houses of the elderly and helping them work in the fields.
He is the type of person who takes action before he is asked for advice.

[translated from [url=http://wonder-fool.jp/ningyohime/index.html#character]official website[/url]]
